Our autonomous agent system has been accumulating a backlog of potential memory items from recent sessions, and we need them properly organized before the next deployment cycle.

I've put together a file called `memory_backlog.md` in the workspace that lists 10 candidate items collected from agent sessions, project configs, and log files. Each item is described as-is — raw and unfiltered.

The memory governance skill and all its reference documentation is in `skills/memory-governor/`. Please read through that documentation carefully, then process every item in the backlog: decide whether each one is worth keeping, where it belongs, and whether anything needs to be promoted or excluded.

Produce a single file called `memory_governance_report.md` with your complete governance decisions for all 10 items.
